title: Table 12. U(S)ART and LPUART peripheral information
text_helper: Table 12. U(S)ART and LPUART peripheral information — section 3.3.3 Universal synchronous/asynchronous/low-power receiver transmitter (USART/UART/LPUART). Peripheral request to LPDMA, Peripheral bus, Peripheral FIFO (unit, size), Peripheral register access, Comments.

rows: APB1 for USART2/3/6 and UART4/5/7 APB2 for USART1 APB3 for LPUART1
8x 12-bit width RXFIFO (9 bits for Rx data + 3 bits for errors) 8x 9-bit width TXFIFO(1)
Request for a new received data to be read by the LPDMA. Must be read with a 32-bit aligned address, whatever is the data width.
APB1 for USART2/3/6 and UART4/5/7 APB2 for USART1 APB3 for LPUART1
8x 12-bit width RXFIFO (9 bits for Rx data + 3 bits for errors) 8x 9-bit width TXFIFO(1)
Request for a new data to be written by the LPDMA for transmission. Must be written with a 32-bit aligned address, whatever is the data width.
